Class BiquadFilterDesigner

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.math.filter.internal.BiquadFilterDesigner
public final class BiquadFilterDesigner extends Object
Implementation entrypoint for BiquadFilter's static design factories. Lives in this sub-package to keep the design machinery (complex arithmetic, Jacobi elliptic functions, ZPK→SOS conversion) out of the public org.wpilib.math.filter surface.

Robot code should call the factories on BiquadFilter directly — those handle argument validation and wrap the section list in a ready-to-run filter. Calling into this class is supported for niche cases (e.g. inspecting the section list before constructing a filter) but is not part of the documented public API.

Each classical-IIR factory (Butterworth, Chebyshev I/II, Elliptic) drives the same three-step pipeline that scipy.signal.iirfilter does:

  1. AnalogPrototypes — analog LP prototype, cutoff 1 rad/s
  2. BilinearTransform.designFromAnalogLp(Zpk, BiquadFilter.Kind, double, double, double): kind-specific frequency transform via Zpk, bilinear analog→digital at sample rate fs, then ZPK→SOS biquad pairing

SciPy reference for the whole pipeline: https://github.com/scipy/scipy/blob/main/scipy/signal/_filter_design.py (functions iirfilter, butter, cheby1, cheby2, ellip).

notch and movingAverage are closed-form and do not go through the prototype/bilinear path. They are documented inline below.

    • butterworth

      public static BiquadFilter.Section[] butterworth(BiquadFilter.Kind kind, int order, double sampleRate, double lowCutoff, double highCutoff)
      Designs a Butterworth IIR band-pass or band-stop filter.
      Parameters:
      kind - Must be BandPass or BandStop.
      order - Prototype order (>= 1).
      sampleRate - Sample rate (Hz). Must be positive.
      lowCutoff - Low edge of the band (Hz). Must satisfy 0 < lowCutoff < highCutoff < sampleRate/2.
      highCutoff - High edge of the band (Hz).
      Returns:
      The cascade of biquad sections implementing the filter.
      See Also:
      • BiquadFilter.butterworth(Kind, int, double, double, double)

    • chebyshevI

      public static BiquadFilter.Section[] chebyshevI(BiquadFilter.Kind kind, int order, double sampleRate, double lowCutoff, double highCutoff, double rippleDb)
      Designs a Chebyshev Type I IIR band-pass or band-stop filter.
      Parameters:
      kind - Must be BandPass or BandStop.
      order - Prototype order (>= 1). The cascade has 2*order poles.
      sampleRate - Sample rate (Hz). Must be positive.
      lowCutoff - Low edge of the band (Hz). Must satisfy 0 < lowCutoff < highCutoff < sampleRate/2.
      highCutoff - High edge of the band (Hz).
      rippleDb - Peak-to-peak passband ripple in dB. Must be > 0.
      Returns:
      The cascade of biquad sections implementing the filter.
      See Also:
      • BiquadFilter.chebyshevI(Kind, int, double, double, double, double)
